rssScope: Sum of this Chromium browser process RSS sampled every ~50ms and at boundaries. Includes renderer/Worker/WASM resident pages; shared pages can be counted repeatedly. Observed sampled maximum, not exact physical peak; harness snapshot retention is identical in both variants.
memoryScope: Main thread JS heap checkpoints and post-disposal CDP heap, explicit transport buffers and Worker index metrics. Does not measure full process/WASM/GPU peak. Harness retains snapshots until each cycle ends to check no detach.

runs.note: Benchmark retains snapshot references to verify ownership; bytes across run are not simultaneous production residency. Worker metrics report indexes, not total WASM memory.
